blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.q: What and where is Websters Corners?
faq.a: Websters Corners (the City spells it Webster's Corners) is a rural acreage community at the east edge of the City of Maple Ridge, near the Mission border just off Dewdney Trunk Road — it is both a City neighbourhood name and the board/Paragon sub-area name, and the City notes its BCIT Woodlot mountain-bike trails and film-production activity.

Webster's Corners Elementary (25554 Dewdney Trunk Road), Blue Mountain Elementary (12453 248 Street, per the BC Ministry K-12 file) and Garibaldi Secondary (24789 Dewdney Trunk Road) are physically in the area; for the sample address 25554 Dewdney Trunk Road the SD42 locator gives Webster's Corners Elementary and Garibaldi Secondary — check any other address in the locator.
